name: DDE Acquisition Activity
abstract: Narrows cdifProvActivity for DDE acquisition. Requires at least one instrument typed with a DDE acquisition category (dde:sensorType, dde:platform, dde:equipment, dde:signalGenerator) alongside the Wikidata measuring-instrument term cdifProvActivity already requires. A DataCollector participant is permitted but not required, because the DDE XSD has no collector element. Defines properties: schema:instrument, schema:participant. Uses building blocks: cdifProvActivity (cdifDataType).
